name: City Rock by Isa Moura
author: isammt
description:
MAKE SURE SOUND IS ENABLED NEAR THE FULLSCREEN BUTTON.
This is a vertical slice of a level of a game I've build. The goal is to reach the taxi. You will face enemies along the way, and you have to be careful to not fall off the buildings of City Rock. Good luck. You can keep track of the time you took and beat your scores. More would be added in a real level, such as gems and powers. More enemies and better weapons.
